strategy_catalog.name: Momentum follow
strategy_catalog.description: When a contract repriced by 10c+ on confirmed trades or two-sided quotes, the move often continues for a few ticks. Buy YES in the direction of the move.

strategy_catalog.name: Mean reversion (fade the panic)
strategy_catalog.description: A sharp DOWN move in a market that is still above 25c is often a liquidity gap rather than news. Buy YES into the drop and exit on the bounce.

strategy_catalog.name: Cheap tail (longshot)
strategy_catalog.description: Low-priced contracts offer large payout multiples. Only enter when the swing is large, confirmed, and the book can absorb the order within 10 cents.

strategy_catalog.name: Favorite carry
strategy_catalog.description: High-priced favourites that dip on noise tend to revert. Small edge, high hit rate; held to resolution to collect the full $1 payout.

strategy_catalog.name: News catalyst
strategy_catalog.description: Only trade swings that coincide with a headline from a trusted outlet in the lookback window. Fewer trades, higher conviction.

strategy_catalog.name: Baseline control
strategy_catalog.description: Equal-sized YES entry on every qualifying swing. No filtering at all. Used as the benchmark every other strategy must beat.
